contacts_organization_email_key.name: contacts_organization_email_key
contacts_organization_email_key.where: "contacts"."email" is not null and "contacts"."archived_at" is null

leads_converted_check.name: leads_converted_check
leads_converted_check.value: ("leads"."status" = 'converted') = ("leads"."converted_at" is not null and "leads"."converted_company_id" is not null)

time_entries_one_running_timer_key.name: time_entries_one_running_timer_key
time_entries_one_running_timer_key.where: "time_entries"."started_at" is not null and "time_entries"."ended_at" is null

time_entries_running_check.name: time_entries_running_check
time_entries_running_check.value: ("time_entries"."duration_seconds" is null) = ("time_entries"."started_at" is not null and "time_entries"."ended_at" is null)

time_entries_ended_check.name: time_entries_ended_check
time_entries_ended_check.value: "time_entries"."ended_at" is null or ("time_entries"."started_at" is not null and "time_entries"."ended_at" >= "time_entries"."started_at")

time_entries_billable_source_check.name: time_entries_billable_source_check
time_entries_billable_source_check.value: ("time_entries"."billable_rate_minor" is null) = ("time_entries"."billable_rate_source" is null) and "time_entries"."billable_rate_source" in ('project_member', 'member', 'organization')

time_entries_cost_source_check.name: time_entries_cost_source_check
time_entries_cost_source_check.value: ("time_entries"."cost_rate_minor" is null) = ("time_entries"."cost_rate_source" is null) and "time_entries"."cost_rate_source" in ('project_member', 'member', 'organization')

invoice_lines_tax_snapshot_check.name: invoice_lines_tax_snapshot_check
invoice_lines_tax_snapshot_check.value: ("invoice_lines"."tax_rate_id" is null) = ("invoice_lines"."tax_name" is null) and ("invoice_lines"."tax_name" is null) = ("invoice_lines"."tax_rate_pct_snapshot" is null)

invoices_issued_check.name: invoices_issued_check
invoices_issued_check.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'draft') = ("invoices"."sent_at" is null and "invoices"."issue_date" is null and "invoices"."due_date" is null and "invoices"."exchange_rate_to_base" is null and "invoices"."base_currency" is null and "invoices"."total_base_minor" is null)

quote_lines_tax_snapshot_check.name: quote_lines_tax_snapshot_check
quote_lines_tax_snapshot_check.value: ("quote_lines"."tax_rate_id" is null) = ("quote_lines"."tax_name" is null) and ("quote_lines"."tax_name" is null) = ("quote_lines"."tax_rate_pct_snapshot" is null)

quotes_issued_check.name: quotes_issued_check
quotes_issued_check.value: ("quotes"."status" = 'draft') = ("quotes"."sent_at" is null and "quotes"."issue_date" is null and "quotes"."exchange_rate_to_base" is null and "quotes"."base_currency" is null and "quotes"."total_base_minor" is null)
